algorithm.data: Target basis and sectors derived from production Rust RGB definitions; target-specific first-lower-root seed fits; numeric incumbent P3 data pinned. Generated files are build inputs, with no fitting or allocation during mapping.
algorithm.seed_fit: Four Chebyshev-sampled pieces in direction coordinates, emitted in balanced monomial form; red tip uses a square-root coordinate. Eighteen terms each for sRGB/P3, twenty-two for Rec.2020 green/blue and eighteen for red.
algorithm.fold_precision: Native f32 two-component coefficients/evaluation and small-angle polynomial sin/cos only inside the fold windows. First outward roots isolated by stationary intervals and bisection. Constants split at compile time; no f64 runtime widening.
algorithm.fold_regression_coverage: Each reproducer plus 32 adjacent representable hues on each side, with -360/0/+360 wrapping; linear limit 2e-6 f32 and 2e-11 f64.
algorithm.policy: First exit from neutral. Intrinsic input-chroma comparisons in both modes; normalized polynomial conversion below first exit, not canonical bit preservation. Outer in-gamut islands beyond first exit are reduced. Both modes must be bit-identical.
algorithm.recovery: Ordinary paths retain upper-first shortcut, competing-face retry and first-root fallback. Stationary face touches that stay inside on both sides are skipped.

validation.oracle: Independent XYZ/physical-chroma stationary-interval first-exit oracle, not the normalized production basis or fitted seed path.
validation.corpus: 99 lightnesses x 720 half-degree hues; near-white 1-2^-n through the native mantissa; subnormal/tiny lightness; 8001 hues across each fold at 13 lightnesses; 21 x 201 neighbourhoods at each RGB primary/secondary. Six chromas per ray and both modes. Counts include repeats.
validation.cross_method: Dualray/direct first-exit linear comparison for every target; other existing comparisons retained. NaN/error and mode-mismatch injections include Dualray. A separate injected dark error proves the historical P3 encoded gate remains enforced.

compatibility.manifest: Grid + benchmark random + 32768 mixed and 32768 low-C inputs (mulberry32 0x6d756c74) + 144 endpoint/extreme-hue inputs. Every output channel serialized as native bits.

assembly_audit.note: Six native-f32 target/mode wrappers, including aliases and recursively inspected outlined local callees. No double arithmetic or widening; normal libm imports are f32.

manifest.random: Independent stratified/jittered then shuffled H/L, C=0.4
manifest.precision: f64 originals, f32 rounded before timing

benchmark.checksum: All three channels widened/accumulated per sample, consumed with black_box before timer stops. Construction, cache warmup, mode/gamut dispatch outside timing.
benchmark.scope: All binaries rebuilt with identical native release flags. Same executable path, fixed CPU affinity, ASLR disabled, reverse process/target orders. No builds or tests during timing. Medians of two process medians include all code-layout and validation/setup effects; they do not isolate abstraction overhead or conditioning cost.

followup.reason: Initial P3 f64 cached cubic checked-grid slowdown of 15.3 percent; repeat the unchanged binaries in ABBA order.
followup.assembly_note: Compared all 969 instructions in the 5188-byte cached checked timing closure after normalizing branch destinations, resolving GOT call targets and comparing referenced constant bytes. Instructions, registers, constants and control flow match; only addresses differ. This supports a placement/build-context explanation, not an added kernel operation.
followup.result: Checked-grid cached cubic remains about 15.4 percent slower than c2f99ba in the repeat. The initial 4.4 percent Dualray f32 checked-random slowdown does not repeat: -0.05 percent. No layout-specific workaround or compiler flag was adopted.

limitations: Accuracy results are corpus measurements on these builds, not full-domain or cross-platform proofs.
P3 compatibility is sampled; the stationary-touch recovery fix can change other inputs.
Targets and methods have distinct fold, hue-quantization and approximation policies. Timing does not establish interchangeable output quality.
Two process medians cannot establish small timing changes with high statistical confidence.
Native timings only: baseline x86-64 correctness was tested, but software fmaf performance was not measured.
